_comment: Copy to params.coston2.json and fill in. That file is gitignored.
Every value comes from a live read, not from a doc or a guess. Run:
owner  admin for the vault allowlist and the pause valve.
Use your deployer address unless you have a reason not to.
asset  FXRP. Read from AssetManagerFXRP.fAsset(), never hardcoded
from a blog post or an older deployment.
vault  An ERC-4626 vault from MasterAccountController.getVaults().
Type 1 is Firelight, type 2 is Upshift. On testnet these are
plain ERC-4626 mocks, which is fine and should be said plainly
in the README rather than implied to be yield-bearing.
